mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25 percentage points over the next month, investors anticipate higher future inflation and discount future cash flows more heavily, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25pp in the subsequent month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified FEDFUNDS rise episode (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS rise is not confirmed by CPIAUCSL acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS for three consecutive months, accompanied by rising GDP demand proxies (GDPC1), predicts a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as lower borrowing costs boost equity valuation.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls for 3 consecutive months and GDPC1 increases over the same period
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform a 95% confidence interval constructed from pre-trigger periods (p > 0.05), or GDPC1 does not show a statistically significant increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) coinciding with a decline in UNRATE (labor market slack) predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as strong hiring signals economic resilience and corporate optimism.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% in a month while UNRATE falls by >0.2pp in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >70% of similar labor market transition events (backtested), or PAYEMS/UNRATE relationship is not statistically significant (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in INDPRO (supply side momentum) above its 12-month moving average, when combined with a rising HOUST (demand momentum), predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates over-supply and profit-taking.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly acceleration > 12-month MA and HOUST increases in the same month
regime_hint: Economic expansion with strong production and demand momentum
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during qualifying INDPRO/HOUST events (p > 0.05), or the correlation between INDPRO acceleration and HOUST is not significant (IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 7% for two consecutive months while RSAFS (retail sales momentum) shows a monthly increase, it indicates a shift to labor market tightness and consumer confidence, supporting a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 7% for 2 consecutive months and RSAFS increases in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in >60% of similar UNRATE/RSAFS events (backtested), or RSAFS increase is not statistically significant (IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in CPIAUCSL inflation (accelerating below 2%) for three months predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate a disinflationary bias that supports rate cuts and equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases by >0.5% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns underperform a 95% confidence interval from prior disinflation episodes (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not sustain the decline for the required duration.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS falls by more than 5% in a month while UNRATE remains above 6%, it signals labor market weakness and potential wage moderation, leading to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases by >5% in a month and UNRATE > 6% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative in >80% of similar labor weakness episodes (backtested), or UNRATE does not remain above 6% during the episode.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly peak in GDPC1 (demand) followed by a sharp drop in INDPRO (supply) within the same quarter predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates a demand-supply imbalance favoring short-term profit-taking.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly peak and INDPRO monthly drop in the same quarter
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in >70% of similar quarterly misalignment events (p > 0.05), or the GDPC1/INDPRO relationship is not statistically significant (IC > 0.05).
